a birthday note, just for you

Happy Birthday, Amor!

Have a great day and a great year ahead. May all your dreams come true.

As a person, I know I have hurt you a lot, and I am very self-aware that I am not that important to you now.

But I really want to thank you for being one of the best persons of my life. You are such an amazing person, and your presence literally brings charm to the people around you. You always make everyone happy (because obviously, you are Kushii).

I really don't know where life takes us or how it all goes. But you will always be one of the most beautiful chapters of my life.

Once again, I wish you a very, very happy birthday, Kushii!
